item.text: The utility returns `0` for both missing data and parse failures, and the bookmark view passes that value directly to `resumeSession`. I’ll make the utility return `null` when it finds no usable ID, then have the bookmark view skip resumption in that case while still loading bookmarks.

The code now treats missing IDs as `null`, preserves ID `0` when it is actually stored, and ignores malformed session key suffixes. The focused Drive tests are still running; I’ll use their results to check both the utility and bookmark loading.

item.text:
Updated `getLastPersistedLocalID` to return a number or `null`. It now ignores invalid session keys, preserves a valid ID of `0`, and returns `null` for missing or malformed data without changing storage. The [bookmark view](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_views/useBookmarksPublicView.ts) now resumes a session only when an ID exists, while continuing to load bookmarks when none does.

Verification passed: 18 focused tests, Prettier, and `git diff --check`.
